assets.name: fern-midground
assets.prompt: Create a transparent midground scenery plate for a layered children’s dinosaur story using the reference ONLY for materials, lighting and art style. Wide 16:9 canvas. A sparse irregular low ridge of rounded warm sandstone rocks, small bright green prehistoric ferns, cycads and grass tufts across the LOWER QUARTER of the canvas, with gaps and clear air between individual fern fronds. The rocks form grounded natural clusters, not isolated floating props. Lower edge reaches the bottom canvas edge. Top 75% must be completely transparent. Keep plants modest and uneven, tallest at left 15% and right 85%; center has low tufts and a fallen mossy branch. Sunny soft toy-like 3D storybook rendering matching reference, light from upper left. No sky, no distant landscape, no flat coloured backdrop, no rectangular soil slab, no characters, no words. Genuine alpha channel. This is one single full-width scenery layer, not a sprite sheet.

assets.name: fern-foreground
assets.prompt: Create a transparent foreground scenery plate for a layered children’s dinosaur story, matching the reference sunny sandstone and lush green 3D storybook style. Wide 16:9 canvas. Closest-to-camera large detailed fern fronds, broad prehistoric leaves, clumps of grass and a few rounded sandstone rocks emerge naturally from the bottom edge. Uneven silhouette, tallest at the bottom left and right corners reaching up to 28% of canvas height, lower center fringe rising only 10–14%. Leave the entire upper 70% and gaps between leaf tips genuinely TRANSPARENT. No sky or distant landscape, no solid rectangle, no text, no people or dinosaurs. A continuous natural foreground fringe with organic separated leaf silhouettes, warmly lit from upper left. It must visibly overlap dinosaur ankles when composited over a landscape. One scene layer, not a sprite sheet.

assets.name: rock-midground
assets.prompt: Create a genuine transparent alpha midground scenery layer matching the reference sunlit prehistoric orange sandstone canyon. Wide 16:9 canvas. Only a low irregular broken sandstone ridge in the bottom 22% of canvas, some flat boulders with small cracks, a few sparse small green ferns, golden grass tufts. Rocks and vegetation have soft rounded friendly 3D storybook rendering and warm upper-left sunlight. Natural organic silhouette, largest rocks near the sides, mostly low center with gaps. Entire upper 78% completely transparent. No distant scenery, no sky, no background colour, no rectangular slab, no characters, no text. This layer will sit behind large dinosaurs but in front of smaller distant dinosaurs.

assets.name: rock-foreground
assets.prompt: Create a genuine transparent alpha foreground scenery layer for this sunny 3D storybook prehistoric canyon. Wide 16:9 canvas. Near camera warm ochre sandstone outcrops and a few bright green fern fronds grow up from the bottom canvas edge: irregular chunky rocks at lower left and lower right, rising 26% of the image height, scattered small foreground stones and golden grasses along bottom center reaching 10–15% height. Top 72% completely transparent and clear gaps between fern fronds. Match reference lighting upper left and warm palette. No sky, no backdrop, no rectangular soil slab, no dinosaurs, no people, no text. Natural organic cutout silhouette for occluding dinosaur feet.

assets.name: reef-midground
assets.prompt: Create a transparent midground scenery plate matching the reference bright turquoise tropical lagoon, soft detailed 3D storybook illustration. Wide 16:9 canvas. Low sparse submerged coral reef clusters, rounded sea-worn rocks, small branching lavender and golden coral and teal sea grasses, confined to lower 22% of the image, largest at lower left and right with low patches in middle. Upper 78% completely TRANSPARENT with genuine alpha; no opaque water backdrop or sky. Clear underwater turquoise lighting and delicate pale caustic marks on rocks. No creatures, no people, no text, no rectangular slab. Natural irregular silhouette, reef grows from bottom edge. A layer to sit behind swimming prehistoric creatures.

assets.name: reef-foreground
assets.prompt: Create a genuine transparent foreground scenery plate for the reference turquoise lagoon in a bright 3D children’s storybook. Wide 16:9 canvas. Near-camera underwater reef at bottom edge: rounded golden coral rocks, soft lavender branching coral, turquoise seagrass rising about 28% at left and right corners and only 12% across center, with delicate semitransparent water caustic streaks between the coral tips. Upper 70% transparent, no solid water backdrop, no sky, no sandy rectangle. Warm sunlight filtered through turquoise water. Natural organic cutout edges. No fish, no animals, no people, no words. This foreground overlaps the lower bodies of swimming prehistoric creatures.

assets.name: cloud-midground
assets.prompt: Create a genuine transparent midground cloud layer for the reference sunny 3D storybook prehistoric sky. Wide 16:9 canvas. Wispy small white cumulus clouds with subtle pale blue undersides form a low broken cloud bank across the bottom 20% of canvas, center lower and sparse, tallest clusters at outer left and right. Top 78% completely transparent, gaps between clouds transparent, semi-transparent feathered edges. No blue sky backdrop, no land, no characters, no text. Warm soft sunlight upper left. One atmospheric layer that can sit between background landscape and flying dinosaurs.

assets.name: cloud-foreground
assets.prompt: Create a transparent foreground cloud layer for a sunny 3D storybook flight scene matching the reference. Wide 16:9 canvas. Large soft near-camera white cumulus wisps curling in from bottom left and bottom right edges, highest at corners about 34% of image height, center mostly transparent with thin low wisps across bottom 10%. A few delicate translucent feathered curls around the side edges but entire upper 65% is clear transparent. Pale blue lavender underside, warm sunlight on top, no opaque blue sky, no landscape, no characters, no words. Genuine alpha transparency with soft varying alpha at cloud edges. Intended to overlap wing tips and lower legs of flying creatures, a single scene layer.

assets.name: palace-foreground
assets.prompt: Create a transparent foreground prop layer for the referenced pink pearl-and-gold underwater palace cleaning scene. Wide 16:9 canvas, genuine alpha. Only two modest near-camera clusters growing from bottom corners: at bottom left a low pearlescent shell-shaped wash basin containing a soft pale blue sponge and folded ivory towels, gold trim, a few soap bubbles; at bottom right a small round pearly cleaning bucket with a golden handle and a folded lavender cloth. Keep the entire central 65% of canvas and upper 80% completely transparent. Objects no taller than the lower 18%, cropped naturally by bottom edge. Match reference soft richly detailed 3D storybook rendering and warm gold highlights, pastel pink pearl materials. No characters, no text, no full floor, no backdrop, no rectangular base. These props will sit in front of the moving helpers' feet, without blocking faces or cleaning tools.
